Koh. <he>סגנם</he>, read <cite ref="O00158"><he>סגנום</he></cite>) the Book of Deuteronomy was to Joshua a (commander’s) banner; … he took it up and showed it to the sun &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 22:10">Yalk. Josh. 22</cite> <he>שגנז יהושע</he> (corr. acc.).

Ex. R. s. 45 נטל סגנוס של וכ׳ (some ed. סגנם; corr. acc.) the commander (of the mutinous legion) took the royal ensign and fled.; Yalk. Ex. 394 סִיגְנִין (pl.); Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Ki Thissa 15; Y’lamd. to Num. X, 2, quot. inAr. נטלו סִגְנִים וכ׳ they (the singulares, v. סִנְגְּלָרִין) took the ensigns &c.—Pl. סִיגְנִים, סִיגְנִין, סִגְ׳ (v. supra); סִיגְנִיּוֹת, סִגְ׳.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:9:6">Cant. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>נטל ס׳ שלהם וכ׳</he> the Lord took away their (the Egyptians’) ensigns &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 232:3">Yalk. Ex. 232</cite>; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 23:33">B’shall. 23</cite> <he>סגיונות</he> (some ed. <he>סגניניות</he>, corr. acc.); Mekh. B’shall., s. 2 <he>מגפות</he> (Var. <cite ref="M00196"><he>מגניות</he></cite>, corr. acc.; v. <cite ref="M01805"><he>מְנָפָה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:3:2">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>והפיל סיגנם שלהן</he> (corr. acc., or <cite ref="O00567"><he>סיגנום</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 20:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. XX</cite>, end <he>מכיר דגלו מתוך סגנין שלו</he> ed. Bub., not <cite ref="O00158"><he>סגנון</he></cite>; oth. ed. <he>דגליו מכל סְגָנָיו</he>, read: <he>דגלו מתוך ס׳</he>) recognises his regiment by its colors; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 681:3">Yalk. Ps. 681</cite> <he>סימנין</he>.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:7">Tosef. Ab. Zar. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:1">VI</cite>), 1 <he>הסיגנין</he> some ed., read with ed. Zuck. <he>הטִיגָּנִין</he>.]

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 89a:20">Snh. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ אחד עולה … בס׳ אחד</he> the same watchword (divine oracle) is passed to many prophets, but no two prophets prophesy under the same watchword (use the very same expressions).

senses.gloss: sign in the heavens, constellation; v. אִסְטגְנֵין.
